description:
List available plans for a service type. Requires `project` — use `aiven_project_list` first if unknown.

Use `search` to narrow by plan name (e.g. `startup`). Use `cloud` to see where plans run and what they cost: it takes one or more case-insensitive substrings of cloud names (e.g. `["aws-eu-", "google-europe-"]`). A string that is a JSON array of strings is read as that array. Plans offered in none of the matching clouds are omitted, so `total` and pagination reflect the narrowed list. Get cloud names from `aiven_list_project_clouds` when the user describes a geography rather than a cloud.

**`sort_by: "min_price"` requires at least one `cloud` filter and returns an error without it.** With `cloud`, it sorts by each plan's lowest hourly price in the matching regions. `sort_order` is `asc` by default or `desc`.

Without `cloud`, `regions` is not returned. Use `aiven_service_plan_pricing` for the detailed price breakdown of one plan in one cloud.

This tool returns a list of service plans with the following fields:
- service_plan: The name of the service plan
- regions: Only when `cloud` is set. Matching cloud name to `{price_usd}` (hourly USD)


This tool may return a long list; results support filtering and pagination to narrow large catalogs.

cloud.description: Case-insensitive substring(s) of cloud names, e.g. `google-europe-west1` or `["aws-eu-", "google-europe-", "upcloud-"]`. A string that is a JSON array of strings is read as that array. When set, each plan includes `regions` with matching clouds and their hourly `price_usd`, and plans offered in none of them are omitted. When omitted, `regions` is not returned.

limit.description: Max items to return. Do NOT set this unless the user explicitly asked for a specific number of results.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Use the value from the `next_offset` field in a previous response to fetch the next page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. Matches against `service_plan`. Only items containing this string are returned.

sort_by.description: Sort plans before pagination by their lowest price in the matching regions. `min_price` requires at least one `cloud` filter and returns an error without it.

name: aiven_service_type_plans
title: Service Type Plans
